name: ILDC facts-only InLegalBERT chunk-and-pool sequence-classification baseline

model.head_initialization: AutoModelForSequenceClassification with a new randomly initialized two-label classification head

input.text_source: shared extract_case_facts output only; no retrieval or evidence lookup
input.windowing: tokenizer overflow windows; every eligible facts-only input is represented by one or more overlapping windows
input.primary_pooling: mean logits by source case before softmax
input.comparison_pooling: majority vote over window argmax predictions; ties resolve to the lower label

fallback_if_cuda_oom.reason: Preserve 512-token windows and the effective batch size of 16 on the 4 GB GPU.

selection_protocol: Evaluate after every epoch. Select the checkpoint by document-level mean-logit validation accuracy only. Report majority-vote pooling as a comparison, never as a post-test selection criterion. Load the best validation checkpoint, then evaluate the test split once. Do not tune after test evaluation.
